name: @typeflow/plugin-examples
description: Runnable examples for @typeflow/plugin, one per supported environment

scripts.typescript: bun ../../../apps/cli/src/main.ts types typescript/user.typeflow && tsc -p typescript && node --import @typeflow/plugin/register typescript/app.js
scripts.ts-node: bun ../../../apps/cli/src/main.ts types ts-node/user.typeflow && cd ts-node && node -r ts-node/register --import @typeflow/plugin/register app.ts
scripts.all: bun run node-esm && bun run node-cjs && bun run typescript && bun run bun-ts && bun run tsx && bun run ts-node && bun run vite-build
